name: Oori
source:
Oori is the king of Rusu, having only recently been crowned. He is treated like an older stepbrother by Naala, however, Oori is also her fiancé. In truth, he has actually harboured romantic feelings for Naala for a long time, however, she gets taken by Nasura forces before he got the chance to tell her so.

[Based on the [URL=http://ignote.net/operetta2/benibana/benibana2/character.html#TabPanel08]official website profile[/URL].]
